info.description: Backend API for IIT/ISB university orientation. Public catalogue exposes only published programmes and independently verified details. Staff and candidate identities use separate bearer sessions and role permissions. Anonymous visitor chat remains available without an account. Full RAG, voice and official admission decisions are not yet implemented.
